task: One Off Stax 1.0: STAX.COM, a falling-block game for the OO-1 on OODOS 0.12 (direct 640, double buffered; ten jobs, each with its own backdrop and two-SID song; ES5503 effects), built from spec.md in PLAN.md's units B0-B11
why: new repo and a whole program over twelve units and weeks; depends on the OO-1 repo's unmerged feat/video-640; several artifacts (COM, OGX, SCR, ten SIDs, WAV, card image); each unit is undeployed (verified in the emulator, ships nothing to a runtime)

survey.text: OO-1 repo surveyed at feat/video-640 8bf169f1 (OODOS 0.12, OOLIB interface 13): hw/video640.md (types 6/7, the owner's decisions, costs as built), Technical Reference ch. 6 and 7, Programmer's Guide ch. 8 (GB_DIRECT, GX_FLIP, GX_BCOPY within one bitmap, GX_FONT 8x16, GX_ASSET's limit, DM_VFILLW, the 1.5 MB program area), two-SID PSID support (SID B at D420/D500, chips' model a jumper), AGENTS.md rules, mkasset combine/direct640. Patterns: ../../ooamp (separate repo built against ../6502), rebalancer (spec/PLAN/mockups/.sdlc layout), the sdlc skill 1.2.1. Owner's answers 2026-11-20 (reference/). Mockups, ten backdrops, ten songs and sixteen effects made and approved by the owner; all regenerate byte-identically from tools/mkreference.py.
